notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing MACHI KORO With Everyone.
Based on your feedback, we’ve made the following improvements:

[h1]1.Pacing[/h1]

Previously, we ensured that the "Dice Income Chart" and "Current Order" would not be affected by the "In-game performance Speed" settings, allowing players time to check them.
However, with this update, setting the "In-game performance Speed" to "Fast" or "Faster" will now also speed up these animations:

[list]
[*] The current order
[*] The CPU's Dice Income Chart
[*] The CPU rolling the dice
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618984/c48659625061ff0a998f0c610919397865b9f3c0.png[/img]

[h1]2.Matchmaking[/h1]

Due to the current smaller player base, it can be difficult to find random matches.
What makes it worse is that we’ve found more players searching for rooms than creating them.
To address this, we’ve added a message suggesting room creation when matchmaking fails.
If no rooms are found, a window will pop up asking if you would like to create a room.
Selecting "Yes" will take you to the room creation screen, while selecting "No" will return you to the room search screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618984/058c6e0f534ed3d5741f4dd56a2d44b03fc83684.png[/img]

We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback, so please feel free to leave a review.
Once again, thank you for playing MACHI KORO With Everyone.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing MACHI KORO With Everyone.
This update focuses on improving usability of online matches.

[h3]New Auto-Refresh Feature for Room Searches[/h3]
The room search list for Guest and Random Matches will now automatically refresh every 60 seconds. This means players can leave the search running and have rooms automatically updated and found without having to press the search button repeatedly.

[h3]Persistent Game Rule Settings[/h3]
After changing the game rules and playing a match, the settings will now persist for the duration of the game session. The following game rules can be carried over:
[olist]
[*] Game Animation Speed
[*] Supply Rules
[*] Seat Order (for multiplayer on a single device in "With Everyone" mode)
[/olist]

We appreciate your feedback and suggestions.
We plan to continue regularly updating MACHI KORO With Everyone to enhance the player experience.

Thank you again for your support!
